propositions: The batched-map transient recovery test fails when the batched resolver recovers from a transient Git read but the one-shot per-event oracle returns None due to lack of retry logic.
Production resolve_event_commit is intentionally fail-closed and maps all Git errors and empty results to None, so bounded retry logic must remain fixture-only and not alter production behavior.
A test-local bounded helper _fixture_per_event_commit with up to five identical retry attempts is required to resolve equivalence oracle transients while preserving exact position-to-SHA assertions.
The test fixture must inject transients at the per-event subprocess boundary and verify recovery for rc128, rc0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) modes against unchanged real fixture history.
Persistent per-event oracle failures must stop after exactly five attempts and emit object-store forensics (fsck, count-objects) before raising.
